name: Erudite Trivia: Spin the Brain
description:
Do you remember when you were small, your grandmother or grandfather always were doing brain teasers: crosswords, quizzes, trivia, and sudoku? All these educational games for adults and almost all of us thought it was boring and they were only doing it because there is nothing else to do. That is not the case. They were doing brain training. Our brain is like our body is needed to be trained and looked after. You won’t have the same ease of remembering something in your 70s, unfortunately. To keep your brain sharp, you need to practice, and the best practice is when you don’t get bored. You are playing a game, and the brain thinks that you are relaxing, but you are actually training. Check your general knowledge while playing our game. We have questions on every topic: history, science, even vexillology.

So how does our game work? As you expected from a logic puzzle game. You have questions, and you need to answer them. We designed a new style for quizzes. The main question is located right in the center, and there are two circles. One is for hint questions and another for answers. All you need to do is to match them. So it is a quiz game for adults with a puzzle element that looks like trivia. For each correct answer, you will get points. Ingeniously, isn’t it? Each card with a question gives you three tries. name: Tempo: Slow English
description:
Learn English by listening to podcasts spoken slowly and clearly, made for learners.

Every Tempo episode is recorded at a calm, slower pace, with a transcript that follows the audio, so you catch every word and understand what you hear. A few minutes a day is enough to start training your ear.

TAP ANY WORD
Don't know a word? Tap it in the transcript to hear it, see how it's pronounced and save it. Speak Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, French or Turkish? You'll also see what the word means in that sentence and a translation of the whole line.

MY WORDS & FLASHCARDS
Every word you save keeps the sentence you heard it in. Practice them as flashcards: Tempo brings each word back just before you'd forget it, so it sticks.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
- 100+ episodes, from Beginner to Advanced
- Read-along transcripts synced to the audio
- Adjustable playback speed
- Background audio, lock-screen controls and a sleep timer
- Save episodes to listen offline
- My Week: plan your listening and track your progress

TOPICS
Stories, daily life, travel, business, science, technology, culture, people, sports, entertainment, mind & body and wellness. The serial stories keep you coming back for the next chapter.

name: Spark: Daily Learning Puzzles
description:
Replace doomscrolling with learning. Each day, Spark explores a single theme through thoughtful puzzles spanning ancient history, mythology, movies, food, geography, and more.  With five unique games and new puzzles every day, Spark makes learning part of your routine. Each game offers a different way to explore the day's theme, and each one teaches you as you play. 

Spark's games include:
This or That: Choose between two options to learn more about the day's theme
Links: Find the common thread connecting people, places, and ideas
Chrono: Put events in order to see how history really unfolded
Knockout: Uncover surprising comparisons in a series of fun head-to-head matchups
Hindsight: Pinpoint when and where a photo was taken to uncover the story behind it 

All of Spark's puzzles are crafted by experts, not AI, and designed to spark those "aha" moments that make ideas stick. Explore hundreds of topics in the Library, from ancient history to the animal kingdom, with past themes to revisit anytime. Along the way, you'll uncover facts that are fun to learn and even better to share. 

From the creators of Elevate and Balance, Spark is part of a collection of mental fitness apps designed to strengthen your mind.

For additional information, please read our Terms of Service (https://themindcompany.com/terms-and-conditions?from=spark) and Privacy Policy (https://themindcompany.com/privacy-policy?from=spark).
